target.env: local macOS, Node 22.23.4; remote CI run 41248871047

verdict.summary: Ready to publish as a GitHub developer preview. It is a local CLI, not a hosted service, so billing, accounts and cookies do not apply. pnpm verify:release passed and remote CI is green on HEAD. Fix the open items below first, and do not publish to npm until the dependency advisories and the package name are settled.

provenance: Reviewed main@eb1cfe7 locally on Node 22.23.4 (the default Node 22.19.0 is rejected by engines). Evidence: pnpm verify:release (4/4 steps PASS, 126 s), gh run list, pnpm audit --prod, repo files. Recheck after fixes on branch features/october31: pnpm check and pnpm verify:release both pass.
footer: Source: docs/go-live/readiness.json. Re-run /golive recheck after the open items are fixed.

dimensions.title: Legal & privacy
dimensions.notes: No accounts or hosted data. MIT licence.

dimensions.title: Auth & security
dimensions.notes: No auth surface; execution-boundary risks are documented.

checks.title: Privacy policy exists
checks.finding: Not applicable: the tool collects nothing and has no hosted component. Revisit if a history service is added.

checks.title: Third-party licences permit commercial use
checks.evidence: packages/code-analysis/package.json:21 lists eslint-plugin-sonarjs as a runtime dependency (installed, not bundled); grep -c sonarjs dist/qualitygate.mjs = 0. Documented in SECURITY.md.

checks.title: No secrets in repo or shipped build
checks.evidence: grep for AKIA/ghp_/sk-/PRIVATE KEY patterns over the repo excluding node_modules returned nothing. verify:package inspects the packed file list.

checks.title: No known advisory in production dependencies
checks.evidence: After Lighthouse 13.5.0 and MCP SDK 1.32.2: pnpm audit --prod reports 14 (12 are pnpm repo tooling; zod and minimatch reach runtime). Documented in SECURITY.md.
checks.finding: zod 3.x (needs zod 4 migration) and minimatch DoS remain; inputs are local config and MCP arguments. Not a blocker for GitHub; weigh before npm.
checks.fix: Migrate to zod 4 when the MCP SDK supports it cleanly; bump Lighthouse to 13.6.0 after Nov 3; bump packageManager pnpm to >=11.11.
checks.untrackedReason: Review-only run: findings are not filed until the owner confirms which to ticket.

checks.title: Unsandboxed command execution is documented
checks.evidence: SECURITY.md 'Execution boundary': gate commands and plugins are not sandboxed. MCP exposes only declared gates; dashboard binds 127.0.0.1 and validates Host/Origin.

checks.title: Threat model exists for the reviewed ref
checks.evidence: docs/threat-model/ does not exist. docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md and SECURITY.md cover the execution boundary in prose.
checks.finding: Downgraded from blocker: a local developer tool with no hosted surface. The MCP-with-AI-agent path (an agent running arbitrary configured commands) is the real exposure and deserves a STRIDE pass.
checks.fix: Run /threat on the MCP server and the dashboard server.
checks.untrackedReason: Review-only run: findings are not filed until the owner confirms which to ticket.

checks.title: Backup and restore
checks.finding: No server-side data. Run history is local files under .qualitygate/.

checks.title: Errors reach a human
checks.finding: No hosted service. Users report problems through GitHub issues (see support).

checks.title: Critical-path suite passes on the reviewed build
checks.evidence: pnpm verify:release: check, verify:analysis-package, verify:package (real Chrome: pass/block/mixed/no-chrome/timeout/interrupt/write-error), smoke:dashboard all PASS (.qualitygate/release-check.json). Remote CI run 41248871047 success on eb1cfe7.

checks.title: Last release can be reverted
checks.evidence: Nothing published to npm (README: 'not published to npm yet'). A GitHub push is revertible, and v0.1.0 tag exists at 30fb120.

checks.title: Supported runtime is enforced and obvious
checks.evidence: README.md:77 and CONTRIBUTING.md state Node 22.23.4+; .nvmrc and engines enforce it. (Earlier warn was wrong: the README already said this.)

checks.title: Dashboard loads quickly
checks.finding: Local 127.0.0.1 dashboard, not an internet-facing page. Smoke test loads it in real Chrome at desktop and mobile widths.

checks.title: Dashboard meets AA contrast
checks.evidence: CHANGELOG and docs/verification/dashboard-themes-2026-10-30.json: selected text contrast checks in light and dark themes, plus screenshots at 320 px and 390 px widths. Not re-run in this review.

checks.title: First-time user reaches value from the README
checks.evidence: README Quickstart + 'Add to an existing project'; verify:package performs a clean tarball install, init and run against real Chrome. Install-from-tarball flow is documented (README:116-132).

checks.title: Package name is final
checks.evidence: package.json name is qualitygate-toolbox; npm view qualitygate-toolbox returns E404 (free) on 2026-11-01. pnpm check and verify:release pass under the new name.

checks.title: Sitemap and robots
checks.finding: No website. Repository discoverability comes from the README and GitHub topics.

checks.title: Analytics respects consent
checks.finding: No analytics or telemetry in the project docs or README (grep for telemetry/analytics found none).

checks.title: A user can reach a human
checks.finding: Issue template is done. Private vulnerability reporting is a GitHub repo setting that has not been enabled or verified.
checks.fix: In GitHub: Settings > Code security > Private vulnerability reporting > Enable, then name it in SECURITY.md.

checks.title: Release tag and changelog match
checks.evidence: Local tag v0.1.0 points to 30fb120 (git rev-list), but git ls-remote --tags origin returns no tags. CHANGELOG has a large 'Unreleased' section above '0.1.0 baseline'.
checks.finding: The v0.1.0 tag predates five later commits, and it is not pushed. Publishing a preview with a stale tag would point users at an older state than the README describes.
checks.fix: Move the work under a new version heading (for example 0.2.0-preview), tag that commit, and push the tag after authorization.
